name: Serendipity
description: The Serendipity, formerly known as the Miss Fortune, was a 1550-LEX yacht owned by Delia Leighton. The yacht featured a cantina inside its cargo hold and operated on planets such as Cyrkon and Jakku. The Serendipity cantina hosted numerous patrons, so Leighton hired a Shistavanen bouncer named Curtis to verify its guests.
